---
name: Security report (do not use this form)
about: Security problems are reported privately — see SECURITY.md — never as a public issue.
title: "Do not file security reports here"
labels: []
---

Please do not describe a security problem in a public issue. Follow `SECURITY.md`: report it privately through GitHub's
"Report a vulnerability" (Security → Advisories) or the support address on ProxyFlow's Google Play page, with no proxy
password in the report. The owner acknowledges within 3 days.
